I asked why she was handling ready-to-eat food without gloves, and she told me that she had spoken to her team leader and was told that gloves have more germs. I found this explanation extremely concerning.

Regardless of whether gloves are required or not, I would expect staff handling ready-to-eat food to follow proper hand-hygiene and food-safety practices. The response I received did not give me confidence that this was being taken seriously.

I will be raising this concern with the appropriate food-safety authority/local council so that the matter can be properly investigated.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and reviews the food-handling practices at this store.

one_star_reviews.text: Applied South Australian Nomination with Roshani 2026 Jan. Charges are very high. As I remember, initial call charges 300$ or so for a less than an hour session. In the first round they mentioned that a positive outcome is not guaranteed as the decision is subjective. However, You don't get much value for your money. Application rejected after 6 months. Don't waste your money. All they said is apply immediately, coz it maximises their profit. In fact, my application fee was around 3000 AUD as far as I remember. According to many of my friends, it's too much for a simple thing like that. How many days you need to work to get that much? So, it's not worth it in the first place. Don't buy what they say, think rationally, do not act immediately. Buy your time as much as possible, resist the urge. If you have money, enjoy it, don't waste on these things. Sometimes in general, I feel it's kinda gambling. Don't do gambling, coz there's no guarantee of positive outcome. If you really want, apply with the help of some AI tool. It won't make much difference. I found very good AI tools and they were more helpful in many ways giving alternatives and so on. Be skeptical, think long and hard before you make these decisions. I know a friend of mine, who spent over 8000 $ for different agencies (NOT this one) without any positive outcome.

one_star_reviews.text:
Very disappointing customer service
I visited this store on 21 August 2026 at around 8pm to help my brother recharge his prepaid mobile plan. I provided my brother’s mobile number, and the staff member entered it into the system and then asked me to key in the details.
As I had recharged this number at the store previously without having to key in the details, I mentioned that the system should already have the relevant details on record. Instead of assisting me, the staff member responded in an irritated tone, repeatedly saying, “I am just helping you, you know. You can pay online.”
I found the attitude unnecessarily rude and dismissive. I was simply trying to make a payment for an existing prepaid service, and I don't think customers should be made to feel as though they are inconveniencing staff by asking for assistance.
I was so frustrated by the interaction that I left without completing the recharge. Based on this experience, I will be asking my brother to consider switching to another mobile provider that provides better customer service.
Very unpleasant experience.

I’m extremely disappointed with the way my daughter was treated when she attended an appointment with Dr Amy Kelly.
My daughter was only 10 minutes late, and the reason was that she was unable to find a
parking space.
Rather than showing any understanding of the situation or taking a moment to hear her explanation, she was turned away and did not receive the medical attention she had made the effort to attend for.
I understand that doctors run on tight schedules and that being punctual is important.
However, there should also be some level of compassion and understanding when a patient is only 10 minutes late due to circumstances beyond their control.
We were particularly disappointed by the lack of empathy and the way the situation was handled. A patient should feel respected and cared for when seeking medical attention, not simply dismissed because they were unable to find parking.
Based on this experience, I would NOT recommend Dr Amy Kelly.

I was feeling under the weather and had a day off work. My gp was booked out but I was advised I could get a medical certificate from a pharmacy. Attended this pharmacy and from my first interaction with the pharmacist, i could feel i was being judged. In a short manner the pharmacist asked me my symptoms and I responded. She rolled her eyes and looked straight at me and said 'in my opinion you are not unfit for work' this response at the time really threw me back. She also oddly advised she is not a doctor which makes her judgement of me even more incredible. I recieved the medical certificate and left feeling like I had done something wrong somehow, like I was scum for feeling sick and having a day off. If you wish to not be judged like a junkie avoid this pharmacy at all costs, especially when there are so many other chemists/pharmacies in the area that I'm sure would welcome business and treat people with respect.

To the pharmacy: if you are providing a paid medical certificate service, in a retail customer care setting perhaps the pharmacist in question needs a career change.

one_star_reviews.text:
Seriously, how is a company like Allied Express still allowed to operate in Australia with this level of service? One of the worst, if not the worst, courier services I have ever dealt with.

They have a 1.5-star rating with more than 2,000 reviews, and complaint after complaint says basically the same thing... ridiculously confusing deliveries, terrible or misleading tracking, damaged packages, drivers who don't seem to care, and customer service that simply doesn't respond.

My own experience was no different...
My purchase was worth over AUD$500, and Allied Express delivered it to the WRONG ADDRESS, left outside the door of the building next to mine...
I had to locate and recover the parcel myself.

And then look at the condition of the box.
The packaging is clearly damaged, crushed in places and has holes punched through the cardboard. It looks like the parcel has been thrown around during transport with very little care whatsoever.

I haven't even opened the box yet, so at this stage I don't know whether the product inside has also been damaged.

The tracking information can be completely useless... showing things as delivered or in transit when they're not.
At what point does someone actually look into a company with this many complaints?

I genuinely question how Allied Express continues to operate like this in Australia.

Genuinely the worst customer service experience I have ever had.

I placed an online order for over $150 worth of Pokémon singles. What should have been a straightforward purchase turned into a month-long ordeal, ending only after I was forced to open a payment dispute. The dispute was ultimately decided in my favour because the merchant failed to respond.

For anyone considering ordering online, here's exactly what happened:

Day 1: Placed my order and payment was taken.
Day 8: Having heard nothing, I emailed asking for an update. No reply.
Day 10: I called and spoke to Phil, who told me one of the cards couldn't be found but that he was collecting another copy himself and would ship my order Express the following day.
Day 11: No tracking or update arrived, so I sent a text asking for an update. No reply.
Day 12: I called again. The call wasn't answered, but I immediately received a text saying, "Apologies, I'll give you a call shortly." He never called.
Day 13: I called again with no answer and sent a final message asking that, if the order wasn't being sent, to simply refund me. That message was also ignored, so I opened a payment dispute.
Day 27: The payment dispute was resolved in my favour because the merchant failed to respond.

Taking a customer's money and then ignoring their emails, calls and text messages is simply unacceptable. If the order couldn't be fulfilled, an honest update or a refund would've been fine. Instead, I spent nearly a month chasing an order that should have been resolved with a simple phone call or email.

I'm genuinely gobsmacked that a local business can operate like this. In all my years of ordering online, I have never experienced customer service this poor.

I would like to make a formal complaint regarding the extremely rude and unprofessional manner in which I was treated by a staff member named Katie. This whole 1 star is because of her. People are already having their tough times yet they make it even worse for us.

I contacted them approximately one week before my mother’s appointment to request a change of appointment time. I was calling as my mother’s nominee, as I have previously contacted Centrelink numerous times and spoken on her behalf in this capacity. However, Katie stated that I was not a nominee and refused to assist me. This suggests that her records or the information available to her may not have been updated correctly, and this should have been checked before speaking to me in such a dismissive manner.

The following day, my mother contacted Centrelink herself to request the same appointment change. Unfortunately, Katie was again extremely rude and spoke to my mother in an unacceptable manner. She questioned why my mother wanted to change the appointment, despite the fact that my mother does not drive and relies on me to take her to appointments. We were simply trying to arrange a time that worked around my availability so that I could transport her.

What was particularly unacceptable was Katie’s attitude and refusal to communicate respectfully. She ultimately terminated the call while speaking to us, stating that she would not change the appointment and that she did not want to continue speaking with us.

Customers should never be spoken to in this manner, particularly when they are simply trying to arrange an appointment and explain their circumstances. There is absolutely no excuse for being rude, dismissive, or terminating a customer’s call in this way.

I believe this matter should be investigated and Katie should be held accountable for her conduct. I would also appreciate clarification regarding my mother’s nominee status and why I was told that I was not a nominee when I have previously dealt with Centrelink on her behalf.

I expect this complaint to be taken seriously and would appreciate a response regarding the outcome of the investigation.

Extremely Unprofessional and Unacceptable Customer Service

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at Petbarn South Strathfield. The customer service was absolutely unacceptable.

The female staff member with the black nail polish had an extremely cold and unfriendly attitude throughout the entire interaction. She did not smile once, showed no warmth or willingness to help, and made me feel like I was bothering her simply by asking questions.

She seemed to know very little about the products and was unable to provide basic product information. When I asked her to check the price, she appeared reluctant and unwilling to assist, which was extremely frustrating as a customer.

To make matters worse, she did not provide me with a receipt after my purchase.

The combination of her poor product knowledge, unfriendly attitude, lack of basic courtesy, unwillingness to check a simple price, and failure to provide a receipt made this one of the most unpleasant shopping experiences I have had.

Customer service should not be this difficult. I strongly suggest that management review what is happening at this store and provide proper staff training. I certainly did not feel welcomed as a customer, and based on this experience, I will think twice before returning to Petbarn South Strathfield.

If you’re going to Jason Abbott please get a second opinion.

I had confirmed endo, adeno and pcos and my quality of life was so bad that a 23 yr old healthy girl count go to the toilet, couldn’t eat, was in hospital in and out every month. My first red flag was that Jason had said that asking to work or go to the toilet properly at this stage was unrealistic.

Jason had told me that surgery would do more damage and it wasn’t an endo issue. I was referred to gastrologist, pelvic floor physio, dietitian, hormone specialist, heart specialist while also trialling medications for 1.5 years with a lot of regression. Meanwhile I was still seeing Jason for almost $500 every two months.

After Jason had asked me to retrial a medication I had already been on I asked him about anything that could help and was frustrated about seeing supposedly the best doctor. He asked me what my psychologist thought and when I told him that this isn’t a psych problem he referred me to psych.

one_star_reviews.text:
⭐ 1 STAR

Absolutely disgusted with my experience at King IT.

I am an elderly woman with very limited computer knowledge, which is exactly why I went to a business that is supposed to help people who are not tech savvy. Instead, I left feeling completely taken advantage of.

I originally took my laptop in for help with linking my phone to my computer and connecting my printer. I was asked to pay a $99 deposit and was told this would be deducted from my final bill. However, I was then charged $769, and the $99 deposit was not deducted or reimbursed.

I was also charged for several services that I did not understand and did not feel were necessary for the simple problems I originally took my laptop in for. With such limited computer knowledge, I trusted King IT to be honest about what actually needed to be done. Instead, I was left feeling overwhelmed, confused and extremely disappointed by the final cost.

I was also told that the staff member did not have time to help me or answer the phone because he was the only person in the shop. Yet I was still left with a bill of $769.

To make matters worse, since receiving my laptop back, it now makes a humming noise that it never made before.

In my opinion, businesses that deal with people who have limited technology knowledge have a responsibility to clearly explain what they are doing and why, rather than leaving customers confused about what they have been charged for.

I would strongly encourage elderly and non-tech-savvy customers to get everything explained clearly and in writing before agreeing to any work.

Based on my experience, I will not be returning and would not recommend King IT.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with the EMDR work itself was positive. Tim is personable, and the technique seems effective for what it was meant to address.

My real concern is with Tim’s judgment outside that specific lane.

Late last year, a sweeping conclusion was delivered about a significant relationship in my life, based entirely on one side of the story. There was no attempt to get my version of events, even though I was a pre-existing client.

A competent therapist should know the limits of what they can responsibly conclude from a singular narrative, and there’s a reason couples counselling is a thing; it’s not possible to offer a final assessment in a vacuum of relational context.

That line wasn’t held here.

Validating one client and pronouncing a judgement without hearing both sides of what is often a complex story creates several issues. Primarily, that the validated partner then runs around using the practitioner’s judgement as some kind of “proof text” they’re completely in the right. Black and white binary thinking is rarely reflective of a relationship’s reality and Tim (quite frankly) should know better.

Also worth doing your homework before booking: the doctorate referenced in Tim’s marketing is an EdD in counsellor education not a clinical psychology or marriage and family therapy doctorate. He’s also not registered with AHPRA: he holds Australian Counselling Association membership. Translation = far less regulatory oversight than you’d get with a registered psychologist.

This doesn’t rule out an EMDR session, but it’s relevant if you’re trusting Tim with judgment calls that go beyond that specific technique.

All of the above was raised directly with Tim and Amy in detail, (well before posting) and so, this isn’t a first reaction. Rather, it’s the considered version, after giving Tim ample opportunity to respond. He chose not to. Make of that what you will.

***Update following the practice’s response:

Their reply confirms that “relationship matters” arose in sessions, while asserting these weren’t the focus of therapeutic work with me. That distinction misses the point entirely.

My concern was never about scope of practice or confidentiality. It was about a therapist FORMING AND COMMUNICATING CONCLUSIONS about a marriage while holding a therapeutic relationship with one of the parties, but without hearing the other.

That’s not a relationship therapy question. It’s a basic epistemic one.

Tim and Amy's response didn’t address this at all.

I took my husband out for coffee on Father’s Day, hoping to enjoy a nice morning together, but unfortunately our experience was extremely disappointing.

We ordered two coffees and waited around 20 minutes. During that time, we noticed several people who had ordered coffee and food after us receiving their orders, while we were still waiting. I went to the counter to politely ask about our coffees, and the lady at the counter responded quite abruptly and rudely, telling me to “just take a seat.”

Eventually, my husband’s coffee was brought out, but mine arrived another five minutes later. What was most disappointing was the complete lack of acknowledgement or basic courtesy. There was no apology for the long wait, no explanation, and not even eye contact when the coffees were placed on the table.

The family sitting next to us actually commented that they felt sorry for us because they had witnessed the whole situation. That really says something about how uncomfortable the experience was.

It was especially upsetting to see my husband treated this way on Father’s Day, when we had simply gone out to enjoy a coffee together. A simple “sorry for the wait” would have made such a difference.

It’s a real shame because we are local, but after this experience, we definitely won’t be returning. Good customer service and basic courtesy should be expected, regardless of how busy a café is.
Group size
2 people
10-30 min

one_star_reviews.text: I used to love Cabello shoes, but after 5 pairs, having to throw away 4 of those pairs in the last 3 years, 2 of which were hardly worn, I would not recommend Cabello shoes to anyone. Faults found with Cabello shoes; 1) Leather quality is not good, the shoes get mouldy during storage in their proper boxes, but my other leather shoes (from other brands) don't. I found I have to clean them & expose to sun to get rid of the mould.  2) Sole quality was a consistent problem in all 4 pairs that I threw away. They tend to break for no reason.  3)  The stitches are not real, they appear to be plastic made to look like a row of stitches & made to adhere to the side of shoe where it meets the sole.  The 4 attached photos demonstrate problems I had with Cabello shoes. The saying "You pay for what you get" can be true, but for the prices I paid for these shoes, I'd rather buy some other European brands (eg. Pikolinos) that have much better, long lasting quality & are also comfortable to wear.

one_star_reviews.text:
Beware staying in a property managed by The Holidays Collection!

We recently stayed at Coromandel Homestead which has two houses on the property, booked through The Holidays Collection.

After a lovely family weekend for an 80th, we were shocked to find when we got home that a number of false allegations were levelled at us together with claims of arbitrary repair costs and “extra cleaning” charges against the bond;

- a damaged hose hidden at the back of the cottage which we didn’t even know was there and certainly didn’t use,
- “furniture left in unusual places”. As evidence a photo was provided of an outside chair moved approximately one metre from it’s partner,
- unwashed dishes. As evidence a photo was provided of clean dishes in a dishwasher. The arrival information advises that it is acceptable to leave dishes in the dishwasher and turn it on which we did.
- an old stain on the living room carpet which a number of our group noticed the moment we first walked in.
- old scratches left by a dog locked in the cottage.

Despite explaining to Holidays Collection that our dog could not have made those scratches because he did not stay in the cottage and the old stain was there when we arrived, they went ahead and deducted $295 from our bond costs for “extra cleaning” and repair of the scratches.

We now feel that we have been scammed by The Holidays Collection who used us to cover up their own incompetence in not picking up issues left by previous guests.

If The Holidays Collection manages the property, rethink staying there. But if you do, take photos of every square inch of the property so they can’t make false accusations later.

I have since been reading through the reviews of The Holidays Collection (I wish I’d read them earlier) and I see now that others have had a similar experience.

one_star_reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience – I would not recommend Treasure Hunter Wallan

I purchased a costume for my son from Treasure Hunter Wallan. When I got home, I realised the size was wrong. I returned to the store within approximately two hours, with the item and my receipt, asking if I could exchange it for the correct size.

The staff member told me that once an item leaves the store, it cannot be exchanged. What was particularly frustrating was that this condition was not written anywhere on my receipt and was never explained or advised to me at the time of purchase.

When I pointed this out and tried to discuss what was written on the receipt, the staff member did not properly respond to my concern. Instead, she began talking and gossiping with another staff member while I was still standing there. She also started smirking, which made the whole interaction feel extremely disrespectful and unprofessional.

I understand that businesses can have exchange policies, including restrictions on costumes. However, if there is an additional rule that an item cannot be exchanged at all once it has left the store, customers should be clearly informed of that condition before purchasing.

I wasn’t asking for special treatment — I was asking for clarification and respectful customer service.

Unfortunately, the way I was treated was extremely disappointing. Based on my experience, I strongly do not recommend Treasure Hunter Wallan and I will not be shopping there again.

I understand that doctors have to use their clinical judgement when ordering tests, but dismissing the request after such a brief consultation without properly discussing my concerns felt completely unreasonable.
I was then charged $97 for the appointment, which makes the experience even more frustrating.
I have previously had very positive experiences here, which is why today was such a disappointment. Patients should feel listened to and have their health concerns properly discussed, not feel like they are being rushed through an appointment.

one_star_reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience despite good previous visits

I have been to this place five times before, and my previous experiences with different massage therapists were good. Unfortunately, my experience yesterday 30 Aug 1:20 pm was very disappointing.

I booked a 1-hour deep tissue massage. The massage started reasonably well, but the therapist then began applying extremely strong pressure around my joints and directly over bony areas. I politely asked her to be a little gentler, as I have always understood that deep tissue massage should focus on the muscles rather than putting excessive pressure directly on bones and joints.

Even after I asked, she continued using very high pressure on my back, which became quite painful. I had to ask her again to be gentler.

After that, the experience changed noticeably. For around 10 minutes, she appeared to simply spray oil on my back with very little pressure or effort, rather than continuing the massage properly.

I then asked her how long she had been working there, simply because I wondered whether she might be new and still learning. She did not respond, so I asked again. After a few seconds of silence, she responded quite rudely:

Do you want a massage or not?

I was genuinely surprised by the tone, especially since I had asked a simple and polite question.

At that point, I felt uncomfortable continuing and asked to speak with the receptionist who had taken my booking.

Unfortunately, the response from reception made the situation even more disappointing. Instead of first asking me what had happened or allowing me to explain my side, the receptionist immediately became defensive and started talking about the refund policy, saying a refund was only possible within the first 15 minutes.

I repeatedly asked her to please let me explain what had happened, as I had not even asked for a refund.

Eventually, she said there was another booking and that the massage would have to end, and offered to refund the remaining time. I got dressed and went to reception. I told her to keep the money because, at that point, the money was not my concern. My concern was that as a receptionist, I expected her to listen to the customer and understand what had happened before immediately taking the employee’s side and becoming defensive.

I have genuinely had good experiences here in the past, which is why I had returned five times. Unfortunately, this experience was completely different. I left feeling that my concerns were not respected and that the therapist’s attitude towards me changed after I provided reasonable feedback.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously, because one bad experience can undo the trust built through several good visits. I would have preferred to leave another positive review, but unfortunately, this time I cannot.

one_star_reviews.text:
I recently attended a mediation here, and unfortunately, the experience left me extremely disappointed.

Before attending, I genuinely believed that mediation was supposed to be a fair and impartial process where both parties were given a reasonable opportunity to speak and be heard. Unfortunately, that was not how I experienced it.

I was given roughly 20% of the opportunity to speak and was not even able to fully explain the issues I wanted to raise. The officer then spent significantly most of time with the other party.

What concerned me most was the way the mediation ended. Without giving me any prior notice or an opportunity to respond, the officer came back and told me that the other party had already left. I was then told that the officer was not there to provide a service to me and that she would therefore leave as well.

I fully understand that different parties may need different levels of support during mediation. However, this should not come at the expense of basic fairness, professionalism and the opportunity for both parties to be heard.

I also found it disappointing that, as a male participant, I did not feel that I was treated with the same level of consideration and respect. Being calm, respectful and a gentleman should not mean that you receive less opportunity to speak or less respect in the process.

I do not know whether the officer and the other party knew each other beforehand, and I am not making any allegation about that. However, regardless of any personal circumstances, I believe mediation officers should always maintain professional boundaries and ensure that both parties are treated fairly and impartially.

I am posting this review on behalf of someone who is genuinely concerned about raising these issues directly because he is worried about possible retaliation. Nevertheless, experiences like this should not simply be ignored.

Every person, regardless of gender, deserves to be treated with dignity, respect and fairness during a mediation process. I sincerely hope this feedback is taken seriously and that the organisation reviews how mediation officers ensure both parties are given a fair opportunity to be heard.
Very unsafe organisation to use if you're in a domestic violence situation. Very unsafe. Would give 0 stars if I could.

one_star_reviews.text:
Do NOT recommend Dr Costello.

I started with Dr Crawford, who was diligent, caring and genuinely invested in our fertility journey. She would follow up after procedures to discuss results and keep us informed.

After she left the clinic, we moved to Dr Costello. Unfortunately, the experience felt robotic and impersonal, and treatment was unsuccessful. After each procedure, we had to book a fee-paying appointment just to discuss the brief results. Even after devastating outcomes, we received no follow-up. Despite repeated unsuccessful transfers, there was no apparent change in approach or discussion of alternative strategies, which left us questioning whether our treatment was being adequately reviewed. It was only more than six months later that the nurses contacted us to ask if we wanted to do another cycle.

While I appreciate doctors may not be obligated to check in, when you’re paying such a large amount of money, basic communication and compassion should be part of the experience. In our experience, good doctors understand the emotional impact and take the time to follow up, even if it’s just a phone call.

Communication and processes were challenging throughout, and we were left feeling like a number rather than patients. I would encourage others to consider alternative doctors or centres.

I have changed my name for privacy reasons.

I only tried this place because my sister tagged me along after seeing their July promotion. Unfortunately, the overall experience was very terrible.

During my teeth whitening, the whitening gel appears to have come into contact with my lower lip, resulting in a significant chemical burn. My lip became swollen, blistered and extremely painful, and I had difficulty eating for a week.

What was most disappointing was the response after I reached out. Rather than acknowledging what happened, the response came across as very defensive, with zero accountability taken.  I would have expected appropriate precautions and protection to be in place to prevent this from happening. And at the very least an apology, given this happened at their clinic.

Unfortunately, my brow lamination experience was also not great. My brows looked fine initially, but after the first week they became quite unruly, with some hairs  permanently sitting upright even when I try to brush them down.

Also disappointed that there was no July promotion for me. I was told that the promotion apparently only applied to existing clients, there was no indication in the msg that the offer was for existing clients only. It is important for businesses to be clear about eligibility requirements when advertising promotions, particularly when those conditions aren’t stated clearly.

I hope the business takes this feedback on board and learns from the experience. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning or recommending the salon.

Very disappointing experience.

We waited an hour for a simple fish and chips. After 35 minutes, I asked about our order and was told it was “next.” We then watched several tables who arrived after us get served first. When I asked again 10 minutes later, I was told it was “being plated,” so we waited another five minutes.

When the food finally arrived, the fish was completely raw and frozen in the middle. The centre was literally icy cold and uncooked. I immediately took it back to the counter and was given a refund.

What was most disappointing, however, was the attitude of the staff member. After repeatedly telling me that my order was “next” and then “being plated,” there was not even a basic apology when I received frozen, uncooked fish. Instead, I was treated as though I was an inconvenience for raising a completely legitimate complaint.

Mistakes happen, and I understand that restaurants can get busy. But serving frozen, uncooked food and then showing absolutely no concern or apology is simply unacceptable.

And to the staff working today: if you hate your job that much, please don’t take it out on paying customers.

We drove all the way to Dewellingup expecting to enjoy our day, and this experience completely ruined it.

I would strongly recommend thinking twice before eating here.

one_star_reviews.text:
I expected much better from R.M.Williams Sunshine Plaza.

I went into this store specifically to purchase a Drover Belt. I tried on a size 36, it fitted correctly, and that was the size I decided to buy.

The sales assistant then went out the back to get me a new belt in a box. I had absolutely no reason to think I needed to check the size because I had just tried on a 36 and naturally assumed she was bringing me a new size 36.

She gave me a size 38.

Initially I could wear it on the tightest hole, but after wearing it for a while and the leather settling and stretching, it became too large.

I returned to the Sunshine Plaza store and explained exactly what had happened. I wasn't asking to return something because I'd changed my mind or because I'd selected the wrong size. Their staff member had simply given me a different size from the one I'd tried on and asked to purchase.

The solution offered by the store was basically to buy another belt. To make matters worse, the price had increased by around $20 by then.

So I was expected to pay again, at a higher price, to correct a mistake made by the store.

I subsequently contacted R.M.Williams customer service on 14 June. They finally responded on 4 September after admitting my enquiry had been "inadvertently missed". They then refused an exchange, partly because my receipt says size 38.

Of course it says size 38. That's the wrong size the salesperson handed me. That's the entire reason for the complaint.

They also referred to the amount of time that had passed, despite taking nearly three months themselves to respond to my complaint.

I like R.M.Williams products and have always regarded the brand as representing quality. Unfortunately, my experience at the Sunshine Plaza store didn't come close to the standard I'd expect when paying premium prices.

Mistakes happen. Handing me a 38 instead of a 36 is an understandable human error. What isn't acceptable is refusing to take responsibility for it when I returned to the store and expecting me to spend more money to fix their mistake.

Perhaps losing one customer doesn't mean much to a company the size of R.M.Williams. But this experience has certainly changed the way I view the brand and, particularly, this store.

one_star_reviews.text:
I had a disappointing experience with this medical centre.
On 17 August, I attended the medical centre for a routine check-up, and the doctor advised me to have some blood tests. I completed the blood tests at Dorevitch on 18 August.
When I returned for another appointment on 24 August, the doctor told me that he had not received my blood test results. I then had to follow up with Dorevitch myself. I eventually received my results on 28 August, approximately two weeks after having the blood test.
What disappointed me most was that the medical centre did not contact me regarding my results or advise me that they had been received. I then tried to book another appointment online on 28 August to discuss my results, but my booking request was declined.
I understand that delays can sometimes occur, but I believe patients should be kept informed about their test results, particularly when they have been waiting for an extended period. The difficulty in arranging an appointment to discuss the results was also frustrating.
I hope the medical centre can improve its communication, follow-up of pathology results, and appointment booking process so that patients do not have to repeatedly follow up themselves.
